#include <assert.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>

#include "html_to_markdown.h"

    HTMAlefHandle result = htm_convert("<a href=\"/docs/intro.html\">/docs/intro.html</a>", 0);
